Htet Kay Khaing

Postgraduate Student, Master of IT in Business (Data Science and Analytics), Singapore Management University

Welcome to KayVerse, my Visual Analytics portfolio for ISSS608. This site documents my learning journey through hands-on exercises and coursework, with a focus on data visualisation, analytical storytelling, and communicating insights clearly through design.

About This Portfolio

This portfolio showcases my work in applying visual analytics methods using R, ggplot2, Quarto, and related tools. Across the course, I explore different ways to visualise data, communicate insights, and design more effective visualisations.
